about: What the Snapmap+ product's mod-store client sends and what it accepts, route by route, read from the product's own source and recorded from a run of that client against this Worker. tests/worker_contract_test.js replays it against the Worker under Miniflare; a Worker change that breaks any line fails CI. When the product's client changes, record it again (README.md in this folder) and update this file in the same change as the Worker.

product.recorded: 2026-11-17, store_roundtrip (the product's modsync.c, modnet.c, modzip.c and modbundle.c linked unchanged) against this Worker under Miniflare: a 1.3 KB build in one request, two 232 MB and 237 MB builds of one mod in 14 and 15 parts, a second player's download and install of each, a re-claim, releases, a report of a missing file and the asked list.

transport.singleRequestMaxNote: MODNET_PART_SIZE (modnet.h:57): an archive up to 32 MiB goes in one PUT, a larger one in parts of the size the store's answer names; the store's one-request limit must be at least this.
transport.errorBody: A refusal's body is JSON {"error": <sentence>}; the client keeps its printable ASCII, whole, as the message it shows (mn_error_text, modnet.c:597).

means.404: the store does not hold or serve the build (the gate asks to upload or says it is missing)

put.source: modnet_put_build, modnet.c:1018-1065 (an archive of at most singleRequestMax bytes)

means.stored: nothing is sent and the upload is a success with created = 0

means.any refusal: the start is asked again (up to partTries) and resumes from its have list when transient or 404

accepts.body: the archive, Content-Length bytes (a shorter body is 'ended early'); nothing is checked here, modsync.c verifies every file before installing

accepts.rule: with a secret sent, the same secret comes back

means.200: the claim for this ref and secret now names these builds
means.403: no claim matches ref and secret

means.404: the store does not hold the build, or it is a whole build

archive.form: stored entries (method 0) with sizes in the local header, mod.json first, then assets/<request> per carried file in the block's order, then the central directory, ZIP64 records where a value needs them, the end record; a part of a build adds source.json
archive.carriedExtensionsSource: sh_mb_extension_allowed, modbundle.c (the list, then .bswf under generated/swf/, .lua under mods/<salt>/scripts/, .mega2 virtual-texture members, .baas_<class>)
archive.verifiedOnDownload: msy_archive_matches and msy_unpack, modsync.c:1189-1292: mod.json loads and its canonical hash is the row's build, the salt is the row's, every carried file is present with its size and SHA-256, nothing else is in the archive, a part's source.json hashes to its slice-of
